string.name: name
string.value: Ticket to Orbis (From CBD)

string.name: desc
string.value: A regular ticket needed to get on the plane that heads from Changi airport to Orbis.

string.name: name
string.value: Homunculus's Blood

string.name: desc
string.value: Blood that is made by Homunculus's magic. It has the power to reveal truth.

string.name: name
string.value: Dran's Medicine

string.name: desc
string.value: Medicine that Dran made for his daughter Kini. It seems rather ordinary but it is actually very difficult to make.

string.name: name
string.value: Magic Stone of Humility

string.name: desc
string.value: An orange magic stone that signifies humility. What kind of powers does this item have?

string.name: name
string.value: Magic Stone of Honesty

string.name: desc
string.value: A green magic stone that signifies honesty. What kind of powers does this item have?

string.name: name
string.value: Magic Stone of Trust

string.name: desc
string.value: A blue magic stone that signifies trust. What kind of powers does this item have?

string.name: name
string.value: Unknown Medicine

string.name: desc
string.value: A medicine carried by Humanoid A. There's no way to tell what kind of effect it has when consumed.

string.name: name
string.value: Silver Pendant

string.name: desc
string.value: A pendant with a rose engraving. It is not yet attached to a chain.

string.name: name
string.value: Parwen's Entry Pass

string.name: desc
string.value: Entry pass that was used by Parwen. It looks like any other entry passes but has a different number on it.

string.name: name
string.value: Dark Matter

string.name: desc
string.value: Strange matter from the depths of space. When used in the construction of items, who knows what effect it'll have!

string.name: name
string.value: Vorticular Gyro

string.name: desc
string.value: A futuristic machine part that perpetually makes whirling noises. Once a part of a bigger machine, it can be used to create something new.

string.name: name
string.value: Blinking Dingbat

string.name: desc
string.value: A futuristic machine part that blinks steadily and mysteriously. It's original use is unknown but it can be broken down to create something else.

string.name: name
string.value: Zeta Residue

string.name: desc
string.value: Residual matter from the explosion of a distant dying star that's taken eons to reach here.

string.name: name
string.value: Black Versal Materia

string.name: desc
string.value: A form of concentrated energy, harvested from the alternate dimension of Versal. The dark energy denotes a chaotic element.

string.name: name
string.value: Taru Totem

string.name: desc
string.value: An ancient totem that pulses with mystic energy.

string.name: name
string.value: Mystic Astrolabe

string.name: desc
string.value: A golden instrument used for navigation. Said to have magical effects when combined with other items.

string.name: name
string.value: Antellion Relic

string.name: desc
string.value: An old world tablet with strange markings. These are said to combine with other objects.

string.name: name
string.value: Naricain Jewel

string.name: desc
string.value: A lost jewel created by Naricain, the demon sorceror. Said to add tremendous dark power to crafted items.

string.name: name
string.value: Subani Ankh

string.name: desc
string.value: One of Subani's Ankhs. Said to have protective powers and ward off darkness.

string.name: name
string.value: White Versal Materia

string.name: desc
string.value: A form of concentrated energy, harvested from the alternate dimension of Versal. The blinding white energy indicates it is still unstable.
